llm.summary: The skill mostly does what it claims, but it automatically saves user queries and collected Douyin data to local plaintext log files without strong controls or consistent disclosure.

dimensions.detail: The required Node.js runtime, GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN, and outbound API access are proportionate to the stated Douyin data lookup purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install script, dependency install hook, remote code execution path, or third-party npm dependency was found in package.json or the inspected source files.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network transmission to the third-party API is disclosed, but the primary SKILL.md says there are no write operations while the search, post, and comment CLIs automatically write complete results to disk.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Successful search, post, and comment runs persist full request/result JSON under artifact/logs using default file permissions, with no opt-in flag, retention limit, cleanup command, or explicit restrictive mode.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core capability is coherent: Node.js CLIs send Douyin keywords, profile URLs, video URLs, and a GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN to www.guaikei.com to retrieve public search, post, comment, and hot-list data.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this before installing if your searches, monitored accounts, or comment datasets are sensitive. The skill sends inputs and its API token to www.guaikei.com and automatically keeps search/post/comment results in local JSON log files; use it only where that storage is acceptable, and delete or protect the logs after use.
llm.findings:
[T09] unexpected: Accepted in context: local output can support analysis, but automatic plaintext persistence of potentially sensitive queries, account/video identifiers, comments, and IP-region fields is under-controlled and conflicts with the primary no-write statement.
[TP4] expected: Downgraded: the cited argument-parsing, logging, and package-name utilities are supporting modules inside a broader artifact whose CLI/API code does implement the declared Douyin search, post, comment, and hot-list functions.
[PE3] expected: Downgraded: the .env reference appears only in a changelog entry saying a local .env file was removed; the inspected code reads GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN from the environment and does not read credential files.
[LP3] expected: Partially relevant but not decisive: the skill metadata declares node and GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN requirements, and the source shows no broad tool or OS privilege use beyond HTTPS and local log writes.
[SQP-2] expected: Network calls with user inputs and token are expected for this API-backed skill and are disclosed in SKILL.md/readme.md; the stronger remaining concern is automatic local persistence after successful calls.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in context: search, post, and comment CLIs write complete result envelopes locally by default, including request parameters and collected public-user/comment metadata.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded for security verdict: the skill is Douyin-focused and Chinese-language documentation is coherent with that audience, though broader users may need translation.
